status: Machine-assisted first-pass transcription: detector-proposed note positions and bar bounds were confirmed or flagged page-by-page. No independent note-level audit yet.
limitations: Pitches are detector candidates snapped to the staff lattice; entries flagged in the uncertain field (beam-adjacent, weak head, grid-interpolated, rhythm overflow) need a note-level audit before playback use.
Bar numbers restart at rehearsal letters in the source; the labels in this data count continuously per movement instead. Letter positions in meta.repeats are approximate.
Multi-bar rests are stored as en-dash ranges in bars labels (e.g. 1–13 at mvt II start, 66–106 = the printed "41" rest in mvt III).
Volta endings in mvt II (1./2.) and mvt III (1.) and the mvt II repeat structure are noted approximately; playback order not encoded.
Cue notes (Cor. ingl. cues in mvt II p4) are flagged/sim-marked where detected rather than fully excluded.
Ties are not detected; tie_from_prev is always false.
Tempo mm values (96/72/104) are practice estimates; the part prints no metronome marks.
Bar segmentation on the narrow-bar systems (mvt I F/G sections, mvt III systems) is interpolated from column candidates and counts may be off by ±1-2 bars per system.
